values.note: $12.15 a night: the Indiana DNR's first-come, first-served primitive rate for state forest campgrounds.

fees.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/rates-and-fees/camping-fees/ (First-Come, First-Served, 'Primitive $12.15') + https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/pike-state-forest/ ('Primitive camping is available for a fee'), read 2026-11-02

sites.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/pike-state-forest/ ('Eleven sites are available in the family camping area and 25 sites are located in the Horseman's Campground'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Pit toilets; drinking water is seasonal. Picnic table and grill at each site.

facilities.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/pike-state-forest/ ('Pit toilets and seasonal drinking water are available. There is a picnic table and grill located on each site.'), read 2026-11-02

booking.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/pike-state-forest/ ('Campsites are available on a first-come, first-serve basis. Self-registration is required.'), read 2026-11-02

note: Family campground on a short spur off the forest road east of the entrance on State Road 364, near Winslow. The separate Horse Campground is excluded. --Claude
summary: Base $12-12.15 -> $12.15; 11 sites, FCFS confirmed; pit toilets, seasonal water added. Pin is on the Horse Campground road, ~450 m off the family campground: corrected coordinates given. Not waterfront stands.
